text:
liz: @channel noticing elevated embedding write failures starting ~15:40 UTC, writes to embed-store queue are timing out and some tenants seeing 502s. Looks like redis-primary in us-east1 is saturated. :warning:

ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-214 created  severity: high  services: embed-store, embed-write-queue  start: 2026-04-05T15:40:15Z

tom: quick TL;DR: write latency to redis spiked after a burst of bulk-embedding requests from a customer job -> connection pool exhausted -> write timeouts -> queue consumer retries backed up. Took traffic impact ~8 minutes across hosted and dedicated write paths.

anya: mitigation actions in flight: 1) throttled high-volume client via rate-limit rule 2) initiated redis replica promotion to replace saturated primary 3) switched queue producers to fallback write path (s3-backed batching) for durable writes.

neil: logs/commands I ran: ```redis-cli -h redis-primary.us-east1.pod get client-output-buffer-limit``` and ```kubectl -n embed-store logs -l app=embed-producer --since=10m | grep RETRY```  replicas show high replica-lag before promotion, now catch-up in progress.

support: customer impact note: ~14 tenants saw >1% error rates; CS banner posted at 15:52 UTC. Draft to send: "We experienced transient embedding write errors between 15:40-15:49 UTC. We rerouted writes to fallback persistence and are verifying data integrity. If you still see issues please contact support."

tom: additional mitigations: disabled `client-output-buffer-hard-limit` override from last week's tuning, increased maxclients on redis nodes, and scaled consumer horizontally by +3. Observed write success rate back to normal at 15:48 UTC. :white_check_mark:

anya: running verification job: `python tools/embed_verify.py --since=2026-04-05T15:30Z --check-missing`  will post results shortly. We also queued a background dedupe job for any duplicate writes created by retry storms.

ops-bot: Current status: mitigated  monitoring  link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1881000000  postmortem: scheduled 2026-04-06T17:00Z

liz: please add any eyeballs to the postmortem doc and list queries we used for validation. Thanks team. :pray:
